name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen Giant "Quantum Pretzel" (453.8g Warm Bavarian Sourdough Pretzel)
brandOrRestaurant: Pym Test Kitchen (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: A massive, pillowy-soft Bavarian-style pretzel baked with refined wheat flour—naturally dairy-free and very gentle on the gut when eaten plain without the sharp beer-cheese and mustard dips.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Share the giant Quantum Pretzel with your group, brush off excess coarse salt crystals, and leave the sharp beer-cheese sauce and whole-grain mustard in their cups.
watchOuts: Skip the beer-cheese sauce (dairy + onion/garlic) and coarse mustard seed dip
